selection: For each source independently, K=floor(fraction*N_images); sort by (SHA256 hex digest, canonical image_id, file_name) and keep K. Retain every annotation of each selected image.
objects365_class_coverage: Report all categories absent after deterministic selection; fail without repair.
grounding: GQA and Flickr30k use pilot-only cache verification against measured counts in PILOT_DATASET_LOCK.json; subset filenames must be gqa_pilot10_v1.json and flickr_pilot10_v1.json.
missing_images: Strict pre-cache and pre-training check: selected count must equal existing selected image count; no silent image drop.
lock_file_policy: Generate PILOT_DATASET_LOCK.json only after real subset JSON, images, and caches are verified; never fabricate counts.
safety_rules: All generated outputs remain under pilot/v8s_10pct_v1
No cleanup unless explicitly requested within pilot data root
